rationale: This is an aggregation-only re-specification of the archive's RND_MOAT_CASH_VERIFIED (same three legs, MIN instead of MUL), and min-of-ranks compresses the entire lower two-thirds of the distribution into a near-tied mass, so any change in results will be hard to attribute to the claimed "all three tests" economics rather than to sort degeneracy.

The second leg simplifies to (xrd − accrual)/(xrd + |accrual|), a bounded share measure that is a genuinely different normalization from the asset-scaled RND_CASH_VERIFIED_EXPENSE_WEDGE and sharper than RND_ACCRUAL_NOISE_SHARE because the numerator is signed, though it sits close enough to both archive signals that the incremental information may be small.

This is a lego-recombination of two already-tested archive legs (the R&D-cut leg from RND_CUT_ACCRUAL_INFLATION/DETERIORATION and the depreciation-adjusted accrual leg from GOODWILL_WC_ACCRUAL_TRAP) with no new economic content beyond swapping which add-back defines the wedge, and the R&D-cut/high-accrual channel is already close to the classic accruals anomaly conditioned on investment cuts.

Internally inconsistent as a raw product: a high value arises equally from acquired-intangible-heavy firms with positive working-capital accruals *and* from organic-R&D-dominant firms with negative accruals, so the sign no longer identifies the hypothesized red flag, and the switch from ranks to raw is otherwise a cosmetic respecification of ACQUIRED_INTAN_WC_ACCRUAL_TRAP.

A de-ranked restatement of GOODWILL_WC_ACCRUAL_TRAP with no new mechanism, and because gdwl is zero for a large share of firms the raw product collapses to an exact tie at zero for much of the cross-section, making the sort and the FMB slope driven by a skewed minority of goodwill-heavy outliers rather than by the stated economics.

The accrual-measure non-articulation leg is a genuinely new construct in this archive with a coherent earnings-quality-uncertainty story and a natural positive-magnitude (hence unambiguous-sign) second leg, but be aware that balance-sheet/cash-flow accrual disagreement is mechanically generated by acquisitions and divestitures (Hribar-Collins), so a negative result may just be re-expressing the known acquirer-underperformance effect and should be diagnosed against a plain M&A-activity control.
